entity.name: Kaviraja
entity.description:
An open-source billing software built as a powerful alternative to expensive paid platforms.
We offers a clean, user-friendly interface with everything businesses need for invoicing, expense tracking, and tax-ready billing.
Free, customizable, and transparent — giving you full control over your financial data.
